title: DSIP key-rotation payload
description: Key rotation record (spec 7.5): the artifact an identity publishes when a verification key changes. Signed by the key being retired, or by a recovery key of the subject when that key is lost (recovery: true). The DID document stays authoritative for verification (spec 8.1); this record is what transparency logs (7.7) keep and clients show as trust metadata.

next.description: Verification method id that replaces it.

next_public_key_multibase.description: Public key of next, so the record is self-contained for logs and caches.

reason.description: Registry dsip-rotation-reason: scheduled, compromised, lost, policy.

recovery.description: True when the record is signed by a recovery key rather than by previous.

devices.description: Device DIDs whose delegations are re-issued under next (the device-list update of 7.5).

ulid.description: ULID (Crockford base32, 26 chars). Note: illustrative ids in spec prose (e.g. 01HZINVITEABC) are NOT valid ULIDs; conformant messages and test vectors use real ULIDs.

did.description: Decentralized Identifier (DID Core syntax, method-specific validation out of scope here).

timestamp.description: Integer Unix timestamp, seconds (payload rules, spec 11.3: no floating point).

profileId.description: Registered profile or extension identifier with version, e.g. interactive-media/1.0

reasonToken.description: Namespaced reason token, category.condition (spec 13C). Registry membership is a semantic check, not a schema check; unknown conditions fall back per category.

codec.description: Codec descriptor. Normative form is an object with registered id plus codec-specific parameters (resolves the 14.2/15.3 draft inconsistency in favor of 14.2 objects).

purpose.description: Registered media purpose, e.g. sign-language, caption (spec 20).

policy.description: Registered policy keys to registered policy values (spec 14.4). Registry membership is a semantic check.

identityInfo.description: Unverified-by-default identity presentation; claims carry VC presentations (spec 17). Display fields are claims, not truth.
